title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 46 ]

items.text: No sooner had she seen him than she turned and ran away.
alternatives: No sooner had she seen him than she turned around and ran away.
No sooner had she seen him than she turned and ran off.
No sooner had she seen him than she turned and fled.

items.text: I will never forget this as long as I live.
alternatives: As long as I live, I will never forget this.
I will never forget this as long as I am alive.

items.text: Let me know the time of your arrival so that I can meet you at the station.
alternatives: Let me know your arrival time so that I can meet you at the station.
Please let me know your arrival time so that I can meet you at the station.
Please let me know the time of your arrival so that I can meet you at the station.
Let me know when you will arrive so that I can meet you at the station.

items.text: I took every precaution lest I should fail again.
alternatives: I took every precaution lest I fail again.
I took all precautions lest I should fail again.

items.text: He was such an honest man that everybody trusted him.
alternatives: He was such an honest man that everyone trusted him.
He was such an honest person that everybody trusted him.
He was such an honest person that everyone trusted him.

items.text: However hard you may try, you could never master English in a year.
alternatives: However hard you try, you will never master English in a year.
However hard you may try, you could never master English within a year.
However hard you try, you can never master English within a year.
However hard you may try, you could never master English in one year.
However hard you try, you will never be able to master English in a year.

items.text: No matter how hard you may try, you could never master English in a year.
alternatives: No matter how hard you try, you will never master English in a year.
No matter how hard you may try, you could never master English within a year.
No matter how hard you try, you can never master English within a year.
No matter how hard you may try, you could never master English in one year.
No matter how hard you try, you will never be able to master English in a year.

items.text: The more you know him, the more you will like him.
alternatives: The better you know him, the more you will like him.
The more you get to know him, the more you will like him.
The more you know him, the more you are going to like him.

items.text: He was preparing what he suspected would be the most important announcement in a decade.
alternatives: He was preparing what he suspected would be the most important announcement in ten years.
He was preparing what he guessed would be the most important announcement in a decade.
He was preparing what he guessed would be the most important announcement in ten years.
He was preparing what he suspected would be the most important announcement in 10 years.

items.text: He often came here last year.
alternatives: He would often come here last year.
He came here often last year.
Last year he often came here.
Last year, he would often come here.

items.text: He is used to coming here.
A car is used to come here.
alternatives: Cars are used to come here.
A car is used to come to this place.

items.text: The professor is preparing an entrance examination.
alternatives: The professor is preparing an entrance exam.
The professor is preparing the entrance exam.
The professor is preparing the entrance examination.

items.text: The student is preparing for an entrance examination.
alternatives: The student is preparing for an entrance exam.
The student is preparing for the entrance exam.
The student is preparing for the entrance examination.
